description: This file defines the IQueueCache interface, which is part of Orleans streaming infrastructure. It specifies methods for interacting with a message cache, such as adding messages, purging items, obtaining cursors for reading messages, and checking cache pressure.

methods.name: AddToCache
methods.description: Adds a list of message batches to the cache.

methods.name: TryPurgeFromCache
methods.description: Attempts to purge purgable items from the cache, returning true if successful and providing the list of purged items.

methods.name: GetCacheCursor
methods.description: Retrieves a cursor for reading messages from the cache starting at a specified stream and token.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Checks if the cache is currently under pressure.
